rca of the issue: ContactUs 'Request a callback' bug RCA — Reproduction: navigate to /contact-us, fill name/email/phone, click Send message. Expected: success toast 'Thanks! Our team will reach out ...'. Actual: red toast 'String should match pattern "^(success_stories|booking_footer)$"'. Root cause: /app/frontend/src/pages/ContactUs.jsx line 35 posts {...form, source: 'contact_us_page'}, but /app/backend/routes/sales.py line 102 defines DemoRequestIn.source: Field('success_stories', pattern=r'^(success_stories|booking_footer)$'). Backend returns 422 which the axios interceptor surfaces as a toast. Mitigation: extend backend pattern to include 'contact_us_page' (single-line change) OR change ContactUs.jsx to omit `source` (backend default 'success_stories' will apply, though semantically less accurate).
